_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/ledger/test_life_loss_nth.py. t_fll_watcher is Intermediate Chirography's level-2 trigger with a draw in place of the counter, so the count of triggers is the count of cards drawn; t_fll_spy is the same clause read for each opponent.

cards.name: Test First Loss Watcher
cards.oracle_text: Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn, draw a card.

abilities.text: Whenever you lose life for the first time each turn, draw a card.

cards.name: Test First Loss Spy
cards.oracle_text: Whenever an opponent loses life for the first time each turn, draw a card.

abilities.text: Whenever an opponent loses life for the first time each turn, draw a card.
